worked: Federal AGI = wages 270,000.00 = 270,000.00. Federal taxable income = 270,000.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction = 254,250.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 270,000.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 0.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 270,000.00 + (0.00) = 270,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 270,000.00 - 254,250.00 = 15,750.00, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 15,750.00 / 7,250 = 2.1724138, raised to 3; line 7 = 0.4000. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single) x 0.4000 = 4,360.00. Line 5 = 270,000.00 - 4,360.00 = 265,640.00. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00 x 0.4000 = 2,040.00. Line 7 taxable income = 265,640.00 - 2,040.00 = 263,600.00. Line 8 tax on 263,600.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 81,950.00 x 0.0599 = 4908.805000 = 12,738.18. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 12,738.18.
